c74object.name: evi_sinfold_lib
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_sinfold_lib.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_sinfold_lib.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_sinfold_lib.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_trig.genexpr
evi_saturators.genexpr
About this File:
This file just wraps the 'sinFold()' adaa functions from the 'evi_saturators.genexpr' file for ease of use in the gen~ [evi_sinfold] abstraction and the MSP [evi.sinfold~] define. Not very useful for anything else, but useful if you want to use the same sine saturating waveshaper in your own code.

entry.name: sinParam ( )
entry.description:
Parameter rate gain wrapping for the core 'sinFold()' functions
In 1: type=input: drive, Drive amount % 0..1.. up to 2 is pretty safe, up to 4 be careful
Return 1: pidrive, Pre gain shaped
Return 2: sindrive, Post gain shaped

entry.name: sinFoldNaive ( )
entry.description:
Naive waveshaping, do not use, we use the oversampled versions only
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: pidrive, Pre gain shaped
In 3: type=input: sindrive, Post gain shaped
Return 1: Sine, Sine shaped saturated output
